summary: TPS and CTPS screening data exists in the leads module. The leads/ directory contains: caregist_ctps_screen.csv, caregist_tps_screen.csv, and the customer acquisition playbook. The production README mandates that commercial and unapproved mutation paths remain fail-closed — the TPS screening gate is part of this governance. The API has explicit safe defaults: exports, leads, outbound delivery are governance-controlled and default to false. The live product at https://www.caregist.co.uk presents lead lists as 'Opportunity lists' and 'Lead lists' with explicit consent/filtering by opportunity type (new registrations, inadequate, etc.), suggesting TPS-aware lead filtering.
assertions: TPS/CTPS screening data present in leads/ directory (caregist_ctps_screen.csv, caregist_tps_screen.csv)
Customer acquisition playbook documents TPS-aware lead handling
README safe defaults: exports, leads, outbound delivery default to false — governance-controlled
Live site filters leads by opportunity type (new_90, inadequate, requires_improvement, not_yet_inspected)
